item.title: ImHex: A Hex Editor for Reverse Engineers and Programmers
item.description:
ImHex: A Hex Editor for Reverse Engineers and Programmers

ImHex is a powerful hex editor designed for reverse engineers, programmers, and anyone who values their retinas when working at 3 AM. It offers a range of features to enhance the user experience and productivity.

🔍 Overview

  • A Hex Editor for Reverse Engineers, Programmers and people who value their retinas when working at 3 AM.
  • Build workflow Status
  • Discord Server
  • Total Downloads
  • Code Quality
  • Translation
  • Plugins

⚙️ Key details

  • Byte patching
  • Patch management
  • Infinite Undo/Redo
  • Copy bytes as…
  • Simple string and hex search
  • Goto from start, end and current cursor position
  • Colorful highlighting
  • Configurable foreground highlighting rules
  • Background highlighting using patterns, find

🚀 Availability

  • Download the latest version of ImHex
  • Download the latest nightly pre-release version of ImHex
  • Use the Web version of ImHex right in your browser!
  • Read the documentation of ImHex!

💡 Why it matters

  • JetBrains, providing us with free All Products Pack licenses for development
  • SignPath, providing us with free Code Signing Certificates for our Windows builds
  • Amazon, providing us with free AWS Cloud Credits for our CI
  • Would you like to appear here as well? Contact us at imhex@werwolv.net!
